name: Snap Reel
summary: A food app category menu on a curved 3D reel you drag and flick; a magnet snaps the nearest dish in
about: The categories of a food delivery app ride on a curved drum. Drag or flick it and it keeps spinning with real momentum, then a magnet in the middle grabs the closest chip with a springy overshoot, clacks, throws sparks and lights the chip, while the dishes below slide in from the side you spun towards. Add dishes to the bag for a live PKR total and place a pretend order.
how: Drag or flick the reel, scroll the wheel over it, or use the round arrow buttons.
Click or tap a chip to send it to the magnet.
Tab to the reel and use the arrow keys, Home or End.
Press Add on a dish, then Checkout to place a pretend order.
A demo drags the reel by itself until you click, tap or press a key.
